nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Banana Bright+ Vitamin C Eye Crème for Dark Circles

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin around the eyes report the cream can feel a little oily by morning and recommend against wearing it during the day if skin is oily or combination.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who names dry skin found the thick consistency comfortable and hydrating.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer used it nightly without breakouts but avoided daytime wear because it sits on the skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin or sensitive eyes, including some sensitive to fragrance, consistently report no irritation.

concerns.aging: Reports on fine lines and wrinkles are mixed: several reviewers see a subtle softening with consistent use, but at least as many say they noticed no change in lines or crow's feet.
concerns.dehydration: Hydration is the most consistently reported benefit, with reviewers describing the under-eye area as moisturized, plumped, and comfortable under makeup.
concerns.redness: One reviewer had a severe reaction with swelling, redness, and itching that recurred on a second try; another separately reports the area looking less red and veiny after use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who mention being acne-prone report no new breakouts while using the cream around their eyes.

aspects.libelle: Absorbs and layers well under makeup
High price relative to visible results

extraits.texte: Had a bad reaction to this lotion. Swollen, puffy red face that itches so bad. Stopped all face products for a while. When I reintroduced this… it happened again. RUN AWAY

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I liked this eye cream because it's very thick and moisturizing. It really feels like it's hydrating my undereye area, and is non-irritating to my sensitive skin. The only reason I gave it 3 stars is that it advertises brightening effects, and I'm just not sure I see any difference after using it. For reference, the top picture is the "before" photo, and the bottom picture is the "after".

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great eyecream for your night time routine, even for combination skin type; no breakouts. Its is very moisturizing but does not get completely absorbed in the skin, hence night time only. Its moisturizes your undereye well and even brightens it but doesnt help with any fine lines. I love that its not too sticky or tacky but still not for day wear if u have combination/oily skin. 4 stars only cause you can feel it on your skin even after you wake up in the morning and cannot use it during the daytime.

extraits.titre: A good not too oily eye cream
extraits.texte: I received Ole Henriksen Banana Bright+ Eye Cream for free in exchange for my honest review. The eye cream is not too thick and a pea size amount goes a long way for both eyelids and undereyes. I didn't detect a smell and so far no reaction to it either. It blended on great, leaving a bit of oiliness likely due to my own skin around my eyes being on the oily side. I don't have puffiness and the area for me is not dark so I can't tell if it is working well but I haven't seen anything worsen. I do like this eye cream and will continue to use for nighttime use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ive been using this cream for some time now. It does a great job of reducing the look of tired eyes, and is an excellent base under makeup. I have not seen a notable change over time in pigmentation but it does keep the skin around my eyes smooth. I experienced no breakouts (despite being acne-prone) or other irritation while using this. Would purchase in the future.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As a person with sensitive eyes finding an eye creme can be quite a challenge,however this one is great.This eye creme has a lightweight,yet emollient consistency that applies effortlessly and absorbs completely into the skin.This eye creme has made my dark circles brighter,smoothed out my fine lines and leaves the skin around my eyes fully hydrated.I love to wear this eye creme under my concealer,as it actually sets it for longer wear and prevents it from settling in my fine lines.This is definitely an eye creme that I will continue to use and one that I would recommend to others, especially those who have sensitive eyes like mine.
